title: Installation Jobs: Short-Lead Capping Coil Orders
content:
**Short-lead coil orders for trim capping — Installation Jobs**

The short-lead coil adder applies once per **Installation Jobs** record when the job's booked crew date is fewer than 7 days after the day the capping is approved. Its amount depends on whether the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs carries an exterior color change order:

| Lead from the approval day to the booked crew date | Exterior color change order on the window contract | Short-lead coil adder |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 7 days | yes | $120.00 |
| fewer than 7 days | no | $45.00 |
| 7 or more days | either | none |

The adder is a single amount for the job, added undiscounted. The lead is counted in calendar days from the day the capping is approved to the booked crew date shown on the job record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, no exterior color change order)

| Capping approved | Booked crew date | Lead | Adder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 7 June | 6 days | $45.00 |
| 1 June | 8 June | 7 days | none |
| 1 June | 2 June | 1 day | $45.00 |

With an exterior color change order on the contract, the first and third rows carry $120.00 instead.
